title: Set the email deliverability access level
when: The step changes which email the org is allowed to send: the Deliverability page's 'Access to Send Email' level, one of No access, System email only, or All email. Typical after a sandbox refresh. It is not about email templates, org-wide addresses, relays, or DKIM keys.
steps: The Deliverability page opens directly. If it did not, type 'Deliverability' into the sidebar Quick Find and click the Deliverability link beneath it.
In the embedded Deliverability page, choose the requested level in the 'Access level' dropdown under 'Access to Send Email'.
doneWhen: The page shows 'Your organization's email settings have been saved.' and the Access level dropdown shows the requested level.

verified.outcome: All email -> System email only -> All email. Through the recipe: 2 actions, 14 s, reviewer confirmed. Each change was confirmed by reading the dropdown in a fresh session with no model involved. The same step planned from scratch, starting at Setup Home, took 5 actions and had failed twice before Quick Find typing was fixed.
